channel.title: Comments on: Alone with Thought
channel.description: taoism, taoist thought, buddha, yoga, tai chi, shakuhachi

item.title: By: Dianne Porter
item.dc:creator: Dianne Porter
item.description:
Hi Carl
I enjoyed your muse. I find I know nothing - the more I grasp at knowing the less I know - every so often I impulsively grasp when I feel afraid I notice. In my Christian life I have discovered the way forward is the 'unknown way' it has parallels in what you have shared. I must share the social aspect of sharing these ideas is that part I like. It enables me to be less alone with my own thoughts and feels safer somehow even though that sense of safety may also be an illusion. Its one I quite enjoy.
Thanks for sharing. Dianne in Australia
